notes.title: Gameplay Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Satellites are now destructible. 
[*] Removed instant death collisions for Easy, Casual and Normal difficulties.
[*] Minor difficulty balancing for final boss.
[*] Fixed a typo in the introduction dialogue of stage 2.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=3ZJnuk8Kvlg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Content Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Correction of typos of Mission Select screen and Mission Start texts.
[*] Stage select music would play after the mini boss fight on stage 2, this has been corrected.
[/list]

notes.title: General Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Stage 3 enemy AI improvements.
[*] Performance optimizations.
[*] Sound optimizations, when multiple sounds are playing.
[*] Updated UI colors.
[*] Power-Ups graphical glitch fixed.
[*] Added background layer nebulae effect.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the input configuration to not display when on the level select screen or during a mission. Players now should be able to change input configuration without issues.
[*] Fixed the music bug. Certain gameplay scenarios were causing multiple music tracks to play at the same time. This should not be an issue anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: General Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game has been updated to be compiled instead of interpreted. This will improve performance for low spec computers. 
[*] There were some bug fixes for collision handling with repellers.
[*] Visual effects were added to repellers when they collide.
[*] More Y axis variety for enemies with straight line movement.
[/list]
